gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].

heapOrArchives.title: Dedicated Response Team
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Dedicated Response Team, it does 3 meat damage. Ignore this effect unless Runner is tagged.

heapOrArchives.title: Vacant Soulkiller
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may advance Vacant Soulkiller before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Vacant Soulkiller, it does 1 brain damage for each advancement counter on it.

heapOrArchives.title: Vapor Ops
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Rio de Janeiro City Grid
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

heapOrArchives.title: Corprunner's Shattered Remains
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may advance Shattered Remains before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Shattered Remains, trash one piece of hardware for each advancement counter on it.

heapOrArchives.title: Trojan Horse
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Urban Renewal
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 5 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Fatal Attractor
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Setup!
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

heapOrArchives.title: Chicago Branch
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Chance Observation
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.
